scope: Improve feedback browsing and detail hierarchy
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

feedback--dense-list-compact-dark.png.task: Scan feedback, inspect its evidence and return without excessive summary text.
feedback--dense-list-compact-dark.png.observations: The eight-result count and first five rows are visible; remaining rows scroll below. Kind and status badges align around readable titles and author lines. Inline filters stay on one row. Dark surfaces preserve readable muted labels and lavender focus. No horizontal clipping or text/control overlap.
